decisionLog.decision: Docs is experimental and gated by docs.enabled (default Off); neither the onboarding wizard nor lessmess init creates docs coverage. Settings provides an explicit config-only Initialize coverage action, followed by one restart to activate the runtime.
The existing git.worktrees behavior and default remain unchanged; Settings only adds an Experimental label and explanatory copy.

tasks.title: Settings plumbing for docs.enabled and the experimental badge
tasks.notes: Added default-off docs.enabled across schema, layered merge/read helper, Settings UI/JS, discussions, experimental badges, and round-trip/default/precedence tests. go vet ./... and go test ./... pass.

tasks.title: Server gating of the docs subsystem on docs.enabled
tasks.notes: Gated docs startup/runtime, refresh/seed/Explorer/validation, exclusions writes, and CLI validate/seed on docs.enabled; added off/missing/unreadable/restart state and dormant-config tests. go vet ./... and go test ./... pass.

tasks.title: Initialize-coverage flow in the Settings Docs section
tasks.notes: Added config-only docs.InitConfig, GET /docs/status and idempotent POST /docs/initialize with malformed-file protection, plus Settings status/init/restart UI and exclusions synchronization. Narrow-write, state-matrix, endpoint, and render tests pass; go vet ./... and go test ./... pass.

tasks.title: De-docs the wizard and lessmess init
tasks.notes: Removed docs controls/step/prereq and setup seed routes from the five-step wizard; bootstrap and lessmess init now create workflow artifacts only. Preserved Settings exclusion helpers and normal /docs/seed job plumbing, with regression tests. go vet ./... and go test ./... pass.

tasks.title: Dogfood, README, and end-to-end verification
tasks.notes: Dogfooded docs.enabled=true, updated README and plan, rebuilt the binary, and completed fresh-repo plus active-repo acceptance checks. go vet ./..., go test ./..., node --check web/static/app.js, and git diff --check pass. lessmess validate has zero workflow violations; only the six known docs warnings plus expected touched-tree hash-stale warnings remain for post-close refresh.
